_comment: GA4 custom channel group 'AI Assistants'. Created by hand in GA4 Admin (no API call needed) — see README.md. Put this channel ABOVE 'Referral' in the group so it wins the first-match ordering.

channelGroup.name: AI Assistants
channelGroup.description: Sessions arriving from AI chat assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, ...)

caveats: sessionSource holds the HOST only (e.g. 'chatgpt.com'), never a path, so 'bing.com/chat' can never match on sessionSource. Bing Chat visits normally arrive as source 'copilot.com' or via utm_source — hence the added copilot\.com alternative.

ChatGPT appends utm_source=chatgpt.com to outbound links, so its sessions are attributed even when the referrer header is stripped. Perplexity/Claude/Gemini rely on the referrer header and are under-counted when apps open links in an in-app browser.
copilot\.com is an addition to the audit's list (Microsoft's current Copilot domain).
